en.headline: Strong currents force organisers to cancel final wave of Victoria Harbour Race
en.dek: About 700 leisure swimmers missed the last start on Sunday after currents strengthened, with organisers promising full refunds and a lawmaker who finished the course calling the decision responsible.
body: Organisers of the annual Victoria Harbour Race cancelled the final wave of the leisure group on Sunday after currents in the harbour strengthened, preventing about 700 registered swimmers from starting.

The race, which draws roughly 4,000 participants each year, runs about one kilometre from the Golden Bauhinia Square Public Pier in Wan Chai to the Avenue of Stars in Tsim Sha Tsui. The Hong Kong China Swimming Association said the decision was made on safety grounds and to meet the deadline for handing the venue back to the Marine Department.

Legislator Vincent Cheng, who took part on Sunday, told an RTHK programme on Monday that the organiser’s call was appropriate. He said currents were very strong in the final 300 metres, describing conditions as somewhat dangerous and chaotic, and that his own crossing took one hour and 20 minutes instead of the usual half-hour to 45 minutes.

The association has said it will refund registration fees to those affected and is considering priority entry for them next year if they meet the required standards. Reports put the number of minor injuries among participants who did start at around 135, mainly scrapes and cramps.

zh.headline: 維港泳因水流急取消最後一組優悠組約700人受影響
zh.dek: 周日賽事最後一組優悠組因水流加強而取消，約700名泳手未能出發，主辦方承諾全額退款，有完成賽事的立法會議員指決定負責任。
body: 一年一度的維港渡海泳周日因維港水流加強，主辦方取消優悠組最後一組賽事，約700名已報名泳手未能出發。
賽事由灣仔金紫荊廣場公眾碼頭出發，游往尖沙咀星光大道，全程約一公里，每年吸引約4000人參加。中國香港游泳總會表示，決定是基於安全考慮，同時要在限期內將場地交還海事處。
立法會議員鄭泳舜周日有參與賽事，周一在香港電台節目中表示，主辦方的決定適當。他指最後300米水流非常急，情況有點危險和混亂，自己完成賽事需時一小時二十分鐘，而非平常的半小時至45分鐘。
總會表示會向受影響人士全額退還報名費，並考慮在他們符合標準的情況下，讓他們明年優先報名。報導指已出發的參加者中約有135人受輕傷，主要是擦傷和抽筋。
